mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 56 degrees with clear skies near the Verona Public Library, but please note an air quality alert is in effect with an index of 58. We are currently under a New Moon.

The City of Verona has reached a major milestone with the unanimous adoption of the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This long-range strategy, developed with significant community feedback, focuses on fostering strong neighborhoods, supporting our regional employment hub, and enhancing our downtown area for future generations.

There is plenty to do in our community today, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market and the Puppets in the Park event at Century School Park. You can also catch live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, we have yoga at Insight Wellness on October 12, trivia at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company on October 13, and the Downtown Farmers Market on October 14.
In our weekly police report, on September 28, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash at the intersection of CTH-PB and CTH-M where a driver was cited for failing to keep his vehicle under control.
Today's delicious Flavor of the Day is Raspberry Cheesecake. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy a scoop later this morning.
